questions.question: When Jehu gathered all the servants of Baal, what did he say he had planned for Baal?
When Jehu said he would serve Baal a lot, he truly planned to worship Baal. True or false?
After Jehu wiped out Baal from Israel, what did he do about the golden calves at Bethel and Dan?

answers.text: He did not turn away from them
He tore them all down too

questions.question: Because Jehu carried out what God wanted against Ahab's house, what did God promise Jehu about Israel's throne?

answers.text: Four generations of his sons would sit on it
Jehonadab's sons would sit on it after him
Ahab's house would sit on it again
